text:
maria: morning - quick triage. fncall.kvcache reject spike reappeared in eu-west after we widened canary to 50%. seems some adapters still returning arrays for empty items.

adapters: apologizing - we shipped a change to return [] for empty caches to reduce payload size. didn't realize validator would treat it as array-of-strings vs expected array-of-objects.

alex: can we make validator accept empty arrays as `[]->[]` but require objects inside when present? like special-case empty arrays as valid.

ravi: feasible but smells like special-casing. alternative: add adapter shim to convert [] -> [] (no-op) but wrap non-empty arrays to object shape. sample shim: 
```
if (items instanceof Array && items.length === 0) return items;
if (items instanceof Array) return items.map(x => typeof x === 'string' ? {id:x} : x);
```

sara: console ask: show a mini histogram of `coercion_count` per minute and allow drill into adapter name. we need per-adapter attribution visible in the dashboard.

console-team: will add adapter dimension to the rejection dashboard and a filter for `adapter=legacy-cache`. Also adding an explainer tooltip for "empty-array special-case" to avoid confusion.

finance: reminder: billing_adj must be applied retroactively for any invoices in the window where `soft-coerce` was active. ops please export a CSV.

ops-bot: Alert: validation.reject rate climbed to 1.2% in eu-west (last 5m)  creating SEV-2 ticket.

maria: temp mitigation plan: 1) enable permissive route variant globally for fncall.kvcache for 2h with `billing_adj` tag 2) adapters to roll shims immediately 3) console to surface adapter attribution + samples

adapters: rolling shim PR #78 now. ETA 20m.

ravi: added global route override in runtime: 
```
routeOverrides:
 - route: fncall.kvcache
   duration: 2h
   action: set_variant
   variant: permissive-v2
   telemetryTags: ["permissive_hotfix","billing_adj"]
```

ops-bot: Update: permissive-v2 applied. Reject rate down to 0.2% in last 10m.

sara: console-team - please add a temporary banner that says "Permissive fallback active for fncall.kvcache (2h) - billing adjustments applied" with a link to the incident.

console-team: done. also added a small report with top 10 adapters hitting coercion. sharing in #eng-platform.

maria: leaving thread open for 1h to confirm adapter fixes and billing CSV. thanks everyone.
